source_variant: original V6 already-printing arm; no goBILDA substitution

coordinate_convention.length: millimetres; multiply positions and mesh vertices by 0.001 for MJCF SI
coordinate_convention.basis: Each basis ROW is one local axis expressed in parent/world coordinates. Conventional local-to-world rotation is transpose(basis_rows).
coordinate_convention.rest: Every body in this plan has identity world orientation at q=0, regardless of the mesh CAD orientation. Body origins are joint pivots. Mesh rotations are given in rest_local_basis_rows.
coordinate_convention.qpos: Radians, additive increments from displayed CAD review pose; engineering angles = [0,60,-85,-10] degrees + main qpos in degrees.
coordinate_convention.positive_finger_direction: Right-hand rotation about finger frame +Z bends local +Y toward local -X, toward palm center.

limit_caveat: Main-arm ranges are illustrative windows matching individual sampled audit poses, not validated continuous collision-free or servo-calibrated travel. Finger ranges come from V6 design intent; hardware fit and spring/tendon behavior remain separate verification tasks.
main_ownership_exceptions: Elbow SF3218MG body and its support/ear hardware belong to forearm (level 2); elbow horn, adapter and auxiliary hub belong to upper arm (level 1).
Shoulder servo body/support belong to yaw; its horn/adapter/hub belong to upper arm.
Wrist servo body/support belong to forearm; its horn/adapter/hub belong to wrist+palm.
Finger owners refine level=3. Do not attach all level=3 solids directly to palm.

optional_rotor_policy: For a 10-DOF visual/kinematic model use component.body. If simulating winding or rotor visuals use optional_rotating_body and optional_rest_local_pos_mm where present; rotor angles/constraints and transmission calibration are not supplied. Required joints: 4 main + 6 passive finger joints; optional: 3 spool + 3 idler joints.

validation.checks: Bijective instance mapping; orthonormal CAD frames; reconstructed rest pose; nested joint kinematics agree with independently implemented legacy main-arm and finger audit formulas.
